FileHeader.Text: JTAG & UART - Smart Artix reference, page 7
FT2232HL: channel A JTAG / channel B UART. Physical pin numbers retained.
To FPGA / matching ports on sheets 02 and 03
U30.6/7: internally NC; USB_DN/DP copper connected externally, per source and Nexperia pass-through layout.
U3.6: internally NC on 93LC66B; source tie to 3V3 retained. R228 separates DI and DO.
U23.26/27 and .48/52 retain PDF UART1/3 labels; on FT2232HL these are ACBUS/BCBUS, not extra UARTs.
Only channel B UART (38/39) connects to FPGA R16/P15. X5 12MHz selection/CL and board layout remain to qualify.
